messages:
deploy-bot: rollout finished: service=inference-api env=prod-uswest version=v2026.3.1 instances=120
maya: noticed synthetic heartbeat entropy on the post-deploy probe, p95 jumped ~220ms vs baseline
tom: saw the same on internal smoke probe, embed endpoint p95 up from 38ms -> 265ms
li: are we seeing errors or just latency? any 5xxs?
sre-oncall: 5xxs are flat, error rate unchanged. this looks like latency-only regression
ops-bot: probe-check: /health returned 200 for all hosts, kv-warmup coverage at 73% (target 95%)
maya: kv-warmup low — suggests prefix cache not primed, could explain tail latency on cold paths
tom: is this the quantized variant rollout? v2026.3.1 included model-x q4a by default
li: yes, model-x-q4a was the canary->gradual step. rollout percentage currently 60%
maya: recommendation: pause further ramping and pin routing to model-x-fp16 for prod-uswest until we confirm
sre-oncall: agree pause. suggested quick mitigation: route 10% traffic back to fp16 variant and run focused warmup
ops-bot: routing command: `rbctl route set inference-api --variant model-x-fp16 --percent 10 --env prod-uswest`
tom: running warmup script now: `./tools/warmup-prefixes --service inference-api --concurrency 50`
maya: while warmup runs, can we snapshot p95 every 30s and compare? put alerts if p95 > 200ms for 2 consecutive samples
sre-oncall: setting temporary alert: p95_inference_api_prod_uswest > 200ms for 2m -> paging oncall
li: logs: small spike of KV cache misses for prefixed requests; sample:
```
2026-03-20T09:12:34Z inference-api host=i-0abcd kv_miss=1 prefix=a1b2 latency=230
2026-03-20T09:12:35Z inference-api host=i-0abce kv_miss=1 prefix=a1b2 latency=240
```
maya: looks like cache TTL or warmup parallelism issues — warmup should fix if sustained
ops-bot: warmup job complete, coverage now 96% across rolling hosts
tom: p95 dropped to 46ms on the 10% route after warmup, overall prod p95 trending down from 265ms -> 72ms
sre-oncall: recommend: keep rollout paused at 60% for 30m, monitor. if p95 stays <120ms, resume ramp to 75%
li: also opened a followup ticket for warmup resiliency: INF-4821 (investigate warmup jitter and improve ramp gating)
maya: decision noted. if we see a recurrence, we'll pin full prod to fp16 and schedule a rollback window
deploy-bot: pause action recorded by deploy-bot: rollout_percent set to 60 for v2026.3.1 in prod-uswest (actor=maya)
ops-bot: created synthetic dashboard panel: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/abc123/heartbeat-entropy
sre-oncall: thumbs up. I'll keep eyes on it for the next 30m  :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone, tagging @tom for postmortem notes after 30m check-in
